annotations.title: The receipt wall of a party

description: A HUNTING PARTY is a time-boxed, pooled bounty on Rokha: a brief, a MEASURED goal, a deadline and two pots. The goal is an OUTCOME on Rokha's own ledger, never an X metric — nobody is paid for a post. Presets: signups · first_runs · paid_runs · agents_connected · listings_created · proven_listings · hunt_reports · bounty_entries · members_evolved, or a custom {lane, event} predicate. Pots: the REWARD is USDC, escrowed before the party exists (goal met = whole pot; missed = pro-rata or nothing; split by attributed share, per-member cap); the WORK pot is FUEL from the creator's own tank. Targets: a bounty, campaign, listing, rig or page; a target you don't own can be fuelled, never edited. Attribution: rokha.ai/?r=<handle>&p=<party>; distinct others only; the creator's outcomes never count. Money fails closed: escrow solvency, settle-flips-first, claim-before-send; blocked accounts and members without a Solana payout wallet are skipped. Full reference: https://rokha.ai/llms-full.txt. PROOF: the goal, progress built from receipts, each participant's outcomes with receipt ids (ledger event ids / trace ids), and the payout table with transaction signatures — the same JSON the public page renders. Machine-readable for scorers (competitions and outside graders can score from it): top-level `party_id` (the key you passed) + `participants: [{handle (lowercase page handle or null), metrics: {<every preset>: n, total: n, share_bps: n (0 until settled)}}]`. Public, no auth.
